name: Bastian
source:
An opportunistic bartender unaware of the consequences or power of the device he stole. He appears carefree and tough, but deep down he just wants financial stability and freedom from having to worry about his next paycheck.

Likes: Winning at poker, drinking out with friends, his motorcycle, attention
Dislikes: When others pressure him, house pets, cleaning
